basisReceiptSnapshotHash.description: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for the complete ParkBrief inputReceipts array that authorizes this TaskGoal. It is included in goalHash.

requestedQualifiedCount.description: Compatibility mirror used only when countRequirement.relation is exact. Non-exact relations must keep this null so it cannot become an accidental completion authority.

candidateQualificationApplicability.description: Whether this task is authorized to qualify candidate enterprises. Material, claim, entity-resolution, and park-context audits must use not_applicable instead of inventing candidate criteria.

taskDeliverableRequirements.description: Task-relative, structured completion requirements for non-candidate deliverables. Empty when no finite deliverable has been authorized.

deliveryEligibilityMode.description: Whether count completion uses every qualified selection or only qualified selections that also meet user-approved delivery usability criteria.

completionAuthority.description: Machine completion is governed only by the applicable structured count, candidate coverage, qualification, evaluation, task deliverable, and user-approved delivery fields. Non-authoritative number purposes and compatibility mirrors never create completion by themselves.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Canonical human-readable summary derived from the structured goal fields. It cannot introduce an independent qualification or completion condition.

unsupportedCompletionConditions.description: Known completion conditions that this schema cannot yet represent without loss. A non-empty list blocks goal freezing and completion.

goalHash.description: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for this TaskGoal with goalHash excluded.

completionRule.description: Bounded audit closes when every frozen input has a hash-bound resolved disposition or an unresolved_with_evidence row; unresolved rows never count as qualified.

scopeHash.description: Canonical JSON SHA-256 of searchScope with scopeHash excluded.

numberPurpose.description: Semantic role of the number. Only task_total, min, max, and range can govern task completion.

referenceCount.description: Non-authoritative numeric hint or benchmark. It never contributes to completion.

prioritizationCriterion.description: Business-priority criteria exist only when stated by the user or explicitly confirmed from a derivation. Operator defaults belong to verificationOrderCandidateRefs and cannot create business priority.

evidenceTemporalRequirement.description: Required temporal meaning of claims used for this judgment. stable_identity is reserved for legal-entity identity and cannot satisfy a constraint, qualification, priority, or delivery criterion.
